rules: Death or destruction ends normal active simulation but does not erase identity/history.
Relationships and kinship become historical/changed state rather than disappearing.
A dead crew member creates a real vacancy until replaced.
Knowledge of death may lag behind truth depending on communication/witness channels.
Mourning/grief responses are individual and contextual; no universal fixed timer or emotional script is imposed.
AI cannot resurrect, declare death, fake certainty or complete mourning without authoritative state/events.
Destroyed ships/facilities remain in historical records and may leave wreckage/aftermath if World State says so.
